summary: Qoder International gives every individual account, including the $0 Free plan, 100 Credits per day that you claim manually in the Qoder desktop app. Each claim is valid for 30 days, so unused Credits carry over until they expire; missed days cannot be claimed later. Teams and Enterprise subscribers are not eligible, and the end date is "to be announced". The separate Qwen3.8-Flash daily free usage allowance (Credit rate cut from 0.1x to 0.0x) has ended: free access ended at 00:00 on November 7, 2026 (UTC+8; midnight at the end of November 6). A separate DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (DeepSeek-Flash) 0x promotion ran from October 20 and ended on November 1, 00:00 (UTC+8). Signup was not tested, so whether a card is required is unconfirmed, and data-use terms for free-model usage were not reviewed.
claim_steps: Download the Qoder desktop app and create or sign in to an individual Qoder International account.
During the daily window (opens 10:00 Singapore time, UTC+8), open the Usage panel, click the gift icon in the lower-left corner, and claim 100 Credits. Missed days cannot be claimed later.
Use the Credits with the same account in the Qoder IDE, JetBrains plugin, CLI, Cloud Agents, mobile or web app. Each claim expires 30 days after it is claimed.
